fields.token: $['opencode-go'] as string, or its key | apiKey | api_key | token | accessToken

macos.notes: Only the opencode-go entry. Every other entry (openai, google…) is that vendor's key and is never claimed.

windows.notes: Unverified on Windows; OpenCode may also use %APPDATA%/opencode/auth.json.

endpoints.name: usage
endpoints.notes: 401 → needsAuth (a missing Go plan and a bad key look the same upstream). 403 → nothingMetered: a valid key without a Go subscription. Zen pay-as-you-go credit has no API at all.

windows.label: 5h limit
windows.notes: Fixed table driven by the client. A window without percent is dropped; no windows at all is a bad response, not zeros. Timestamps carry milliseconds.
